_note: C3: passages have no title or author; the essay cites them as Source 1 and Source 2. Citing by number should count as attribution.
assignment_text: Using the sources, argue whether your school should require a foreign language.

source_passages.text: Students who study a second language score higher on tests of problem solving and memory, according to a ten-year study.
Many schools struggle to hire qualified language teachers, and required classes can crowd out electives students care about.

essay_text: Our school should require a foreign language, but with flexibility. Source 1 shows that language study improves problem solving and memory, which helps in every subject. Source 2 raises a fair concern about hiring teachers and losing electives, so the school could offer online courses and count a language as an elective credit. That way students get the benefits in Source 1 without the costs in Source 2.
